gateScope: Numerical evaluation gates only; correctness, privacy and performance are separately evidenced
limitations: Only six seed clusters; confidence intervals are not human-strength evidence
Beam2 can miss costly early moves that enable later gain;128 attack expansions per root, not a time bound
Gift/activeKeyCardsSpent metrics describe action-chain movements, not causal utility or pure active costs
Gift-next-turn metrics can be repeated per gift and right-censored at game end; no unbiased survival rate claim
